# LAME MP3 encoder

`lame-3.100.tar.gz` is the unmodified [LAME 3.100 release](https://sourceforge.net/projects/lame/files/lame/3.100/). Its SHA-256 is `ddfe36cab873794038ae2c1210557ad34857a4b6bdc515785d1da9e175b1da1e`.

`bash scripts/build-mp3-encoder.sh` builds a standalone arm64 command-line encoder. The app bundle includes the encoder, the original source archive, `COPYING`, and the upstream README.
